pattern-recognition.title: Pattern recognition
pattern-recognition.bodyHtml:
AI is unmatched at analyzing large datasets & instantly identifying repeat patterns, similarities, & trends across those volumes of info.

AI Strength

What this changes

Recurring issues and hidden opportunities used to take days, weeks, or even months to uncover. When patterns are surfaced instantly, designers spend less time digging for problems and more time solving them.

How I leverage it

  • Automatically flagging UI inconsistencies
  • Detecting accessibility issues
  • Surfacing top UX friction points

Blind spots & risks

AI cannot tell you why patterns exist. Taking surfaced trends at face-value can lead designers to solve symptoms instead of root causes.

Real life example

summarization-synthesis.title: Summarization & synthesis
summarization-synthesis.bodyHtml:
AI can instantly consolidate raw, verbose & unstructured content. Restructuring information into clear summaries, lists, and breakdowns.

AI Strength

What this changes

Large and messy inputs become instantly usable. Instead of spending hours reformatting notes, designers can quickly arrive at patterns, next steps, and decisions.

How I leverage it

  • Condensing user interviews and research notes
  • Writing UX copy drafts and variants
  • Synthesizing product feedback into themes

Blind spots & risks

AI can confidently summarize incorrect information. If the input is biased, incomplete, or wrong, the summary will be too.

Real life example

speed-iteration.title: Speed and iteration
speed-iteration.bodyHtml:
AI can rapidly generate a large number of possible design directions. Alternative layouts, structure, & visual treatments in seconds.

AI Strength

What this changes

Exploration becomes dramatically faster. Designers can test more paths earlier, make faster calls, and spend more time refining the best options instead of manually generating them.

How I leverage it

  • Exploring multiple directions quickly
  • Generating component variants at scale
  • Speeding up ideation and prototyping

Blind spots & risks

More options doesn’t mean better options. AI can flood the process with noise, making it harder to focus on what matters.

Real life example

scalability-consistency.title: Scalability & consistency
scalability-consistency.bodyHtml:
AI applies rules the same way every time, without drift or deviation. It maintains uniform structure and consistency across repeated patterns.

AI Strength

What this changes

Teams can move faster without sacrificing consistency. Repeated work becomes easier to maintain, and designers can apply the same standards across large systems without losing quality.

How I leverage it

  • Maintaining design system consistency
  • Auditing UI patterns for drift
  • Standardizing components and documentation

Blind spots & risks

Consistency without context can create rigid outcomes. AI can’t always know when to intentionally break patterns.

Real life example

deep-problem-framing.title: Deep problem framing
deep-problem-framing.bodyHtml:
AI struggles to define the real ‘problem behind the problem.’ It can repeat what users are saying, but rarely their motivations for saying it.

AI Weakness

Consequences if ignored

Without human framing, teams risk solving the wrong thing. Outputs may look polished but miss the deeper root cause.

How I navigate this

  • Asking “why” until the real issue surfaces
  • Aligning on the core job-to-be-done
  • Using AI only after framing is clear

Real life example

emotional-understanding.title: Emotional understanding
emotional-understanding.bodyHtml:
AI is incapable of experiencing emotion. That lack of emotional context limits its ability to reason through nuanced human experiences.

AI Weakness

Consequences if ignored

Design can feel ‘correct’ but emotionally tone-deaf. Users may abandon flows that technically work but feel cold, confusing, or unsafe.

How I navigate this

  • Watching real user behavior and reactions
  • Writing with empathy and human tone
  • Prioritizing trust and emotional safety

Real life example

complex-system-thinking.title: Complex system thinking
complex-system-thinking.bodyHtml:
AI misses interdependencies within multi-layered systems. It struggles to model how one change impacts the broader product.

AI Weakness

Consequences if ignored

Design decisions may create downstream breakage. Teams may ship improvements in one area while unintentionally harming another.

How I navigate this

  • Mapping dependencies before designing
  • Collaborating closely with engineering
  • Using AI for suggestions, not system decisions

Real life example

taste-craft.title: Taste & craft
taste-craft.bodyHtml:
AI lacks the judgment needed to make nuanced design decisions. Design isn’t just generating options… Ultimately it’s key choices.

AI Weakness

Consequences if ignored

If a product lacks intentional choices, the issue isn’t just “vibe,” it directly harms clarity and usability. Without clear decisions, the product stops guiding users and starts getting in their way.

How I navigate this

  • Retaining final say on hierarchy, clarity, and intent
  • Intentionally breaking patterns that harm usability
  • Prioritizing worthy solutions instead of endless iterations

Real life example
